directions: When on Hwy 1, take exit 170. Keep left at fork in the road and follow signs for Hope Town Centre into town. In less than 1 km, turn right on Wallace St. Turn right on 6th avenue. Turn left on Kawkawa Lake road. Turn right onto Othello road and continue for 6 km. Trailhead is located on left side of the road at N 49* 23.244 W 121* 19.231.
title: Ogilvie Peak
